company_name: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology
semiconductor_relevance: High — AIST is involved in advanced semiconductor integration technology and offers a variety of deposition processes crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: The National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST) specializes in advanced semiconductor integration technology, focusing on both chemical and physical vapor deposition processes. Their research supports the development of power electronics, sensing technologies, and AI chip design, catering to spin-off companies and other organizations in the semiconductor value chain.
